spec2def(virtdisk.dll virtdisk.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# virtdisk.dll is all Rust (virtdisk-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/virtdisk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
add_cargo_module(virtdisk virtdisk-cargo virtdisk.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE virtdisk-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)
